name: OrderFort Fraud Shield
author: Oltora

sections.description:
OrderFort Fraud Shield helps WooCommerce stores reduce fake orders and suspicious checkout attempts with lightweight local protection that runs quietly in the background.

It is designed for store owners who want a simple local protection layer without a complicated setup. OrderFort Fraud Shield works inside WordPress and WooCommerce and helps flag risky checkout behavior while keeping the workflow easy to manage.

The separate OrderFort Fraud Shield Premium add-on unlocks more advanced tools for stores that need stronger fraud visibility, cloud-assisted protection, and deeper control.

Giving WooCommerce stores a stronger protection base

Fake orders, suspicious customer details, repeated checkout attempts, and risky order patterns can waste time and create unnecessary noise in your WooCommerce workflow.

OrderFort Fraud Shield helps reduce that noise with a balanced local protection layer built for real stores. It is made to work quietly in the background while still giving store owners useful visibility into suspicious checkout activity.

Quick and easy setup

OrderFort Fraud Shield is designed to be simple to install and use.

Once activated, it starts providing local checkout protection with balanced fraud scoring and essential detection tools. The goal is to give store owners useful fraud protection without forcing them into a complicated configuration process.

Core free features

OrderFort Fraud Shield includes:

  • Balanced local fraud scoring for suspicious checkout activity
  • Checkout honeypot protection to help detect automated abuse
  • Disposable email detection for risky customer email patterns
  • Local review and block decisions based on the plugin’s protection logic
  • Per-order risk metadata stored with WooCommerce order data
  • Dashboard visibility for recent activity, IP overview, and recent blocklist data

Built for WooCommerce store owners

OrderFort Fraud Shield is built for merchants who want a practical base protection layer for WooCommerce.

Whether your store receives occasional fake orders or repeated suspicious checkout attempts, the plugin helps add structure and visibility without turning fraud protection into a heavy admin workflow.

OrderFort Fraud Shield Premium

The separate OrderFort Fraud Shield Premium add-on expands the free plugin with more advanced fraud controls, deeper activity visibility, and cloud-assisted fraud intelligence.

It is designed for stores that want more than local background protection and need stronger tools for reviewing, managing, and blocking suspicious activity.

What the Premium add-on adds

OrderFort Fraud Shield Premium adds:

  • Dedicated Activity screen for reviewing suspicious and blocked events
  • Dedicated IP & Blocklist tools for better fraud visibility and control
  • Advanced protection controls for stores that need stronger filtering
  • Manual block management for IPs and other suspicious identities
  • Customer IP visibility and blocked-status visibility in order-related workflows
  • Cloud-assisted fraud signals for stronger real-time decision support
  • Shared fraud indicators through the OLTORA network for licensed Premium customers
  • Improved visibility into repeat fraud attempts across suspicious identities and order behavior

Why store owners upgrade

The free version gives WooCommerce stores a balanced local protection layer.

Premium is for merchants who want stronger fraud controls, more visibility into suspicious behavior, and access to cloud-assisted fraud intelligence. It helps store owners move from quiet local protection to a more advanced workflow with activity review, block management, and stronger decision support.

For growing stores that need more control

OrderFort Fraud Shield works well as a lightweight local protection layer.

For stores dealing with repeated suspicious checkouts, fake customer details, blocked identities, or a need for stronger fraud review tools, the separate Premium add-on provides the next layer of protection and visibility.

See the OrderFort website for more details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip in WordPress or install it manually.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Open OrderFort Fraud Shield in the admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be active.

Does the plugin read credit card numbers?

No. The plugin does not read or store raw payment card numbers or CVV/CVC values.
